articles.summary: When Winnebago set out to reimagine its conventional Class C motorhome, the team rallied around a guiding principle pulled from a 1987 ad for the Minnie Winnie: “Everything in it deserves the name that’s on it.” That spirit became the North Star for the all-new Sunflyer, a modern Conventional Class C that reinvents and simplifies travel for the road ahead.
articles.title: Introducing the Winnebago Sunflyer: A new era for the conventional Class C

articles.summary: Grand Design’s new Foundation destination trailer arrives with a clear purpose: to give campers a place that feels just like home. As more RVers find permanent or semi-permanent sites they love, the demand for destination trailers has grown. The Foundation meets that need, rounding out Grand Design’s full product portfolio so customers can stay with a brand they trust at every stage of their adventure.
articles.title: Grand Design’s Foundation: Designed for the destination

articles.summary: Steve Heese, president of Chris-Craft and senior vice president, power systems, was recently inducted into the National Marine Manufacturers Association Hall of Fame for his remarkable impact on and advocacy for the boating industry. Steve reflects on his beginnings, re-establishing Chris-Craft as an American icon and what’s in store for the future of Chris-Craft and Lithionics.
articles.title: Steering an icon to success: A Q&A with Chris-Craft president Steve Heese
